title: SBS SupTech Standards Pack Manifest
description: Provenance and compatibility metadata for the SBS SupTech standards pack. Lives at the top of every standards-pack tarball as manifest.json. See ADR 0039.

manifest_schema_version.description: Version of this manifest schema. Semver.

status.description: Maturity. Sandbox at v0.1; production once the conformance suite lands.

license.description: SPDX identifier or LicenseRef placeholder. Final license pending WBG legal review at v0.1.

git_commit.description: Full SHA-1 of the build-time git commit.

portal_url.description: Canonical URL of the live developer portal. Lets institutions rediscover updated documentation from the offline pack.

webhook_signature_version.description: Which version of the signature canonical-request shape this pack documents. Carried in the signature header itself; this field is a pack-level documentation aid.

contains.description: Top-level directories present in the pack.

attestation.description: Provenance attestation status. ADR 0039 §6 acknowledges the SLSA + cosign authenticity gap at v0.1; the field is required so a downloader reading manifest.json sees the gap explicitly, not only readers of the ADR.

type.description: Attestation type. v0.1 ships as 'none'; v0.2 introduces 'slsa-v1' alongside the OCI distribution decision.
